The deliverable-archive spec §'ADR placement convention' requires ADRs to land in TWO locations: (1) project-wide registry `adrs/` (verified — all four ADR-0032..0035 present); (2) feature-scoped copy `working/feature/<slug>/adrs/ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md` (MISSING for all four new ADRs).
issues.suggestion: Create `working/feature/execution-pipeline-design-r1/adrs/` directory and copy ADR-0032, ADR-0033, ADR-0034, ADR-0035 from the project-wide registry. This is the standard `cp` step documented in the spec's Patterns section. Per ADR-0005 append-only, both locations remain.
issues.verdict_impact: BLOCKER per FULL-scope conditional-artifact-MAJOR-if-missing-without-justification rule, escalated because Blueprint v5 frontmatter `adrs_added_in_this_run:` declares all four ADRs were authored in this run, so the dual-location mirror is unambiguously required and no `discovery_shortcut` justification exists.

issues.suggestion: Either (a) author the missing `codebase-analysis.json` retroactively from the .md (recommended; preserves ADR-0018 compliance) OR (b) escalate to user at Gate 6 to accept the .md-only variant as acknowledged-shortcut, with a follow-on item to add JSON for future runs.

verdict_rationale: Archive is substantively complete: all 13 pipeline stages produced their primary artifact; reviewer verdicts are all `approved`; cross-artifact audit returned `pass`; supersession chains (Blueprint v1->v5, plan-v1->v2) are intact with predecessor + supersedes frontmatter; agent_invocation_simulation discipline is observed (simulated v1-v4 Blueprint + plan-v1 + audits r1-r5 + reconciliation cycles 1-2 declared `true`; authoritative v5 + plan-v2 + audit r6/r7 + reconciliation cycle 3 + tests + validators + cross-audit + tasks declared `false`); all 4 new ADRs (0032-0035) present in the project-wide registry with status: proposed. However the dual-location ADR placement convention (spec §'ADR placement convention') is violated — the feature-scoped `working/feature/<slug>/adrs/` mirror does NOT exist — which the spec elevates to BLOCKER for FULL scope. Additionally, codebase-analysis.json (the JSON companion to the .md per ADR-0018) and research-notes/ are missing without `discovery_shortcut` justification (MAJOR per spec). Verdict: REVIEW — surface these gaps to the Final Approval Gate (Gate 6) so the human can either (a) direct the in-place fixes (the ADR mirror is a literal `cp` operation; the discovery_shortcut section is text-only) or (b) accept the gaps with an explicit waiver.
next_step: Surface to Gate 6 Final Approval. Three of the four findings (I-DR-DA-002, I-DR-DA-003, I-DR-DA-004) can be remediated inside the 1 remaining reconciliation cycle without re-invoking authoring sub-agents (they are file-level operations); the fourth (I-DR-DA-001 scope_class declaration) is a one-line frontmatter add.
